name: GetWine
status: active - current preference, NOT an exclusive commitment

contact.note: Orders have historically been placed by emailing a contact at the vendor directly rather than through website checkout - worth asking about when you reach out.

delivery.note: Orders always qualify. Treat shipping as zero when comparing.

constraints: Cannot sell single bottles. Minimum 6 of any one wine.
Mixed 'create your own' cases go in 2-bottle multiples.
Vendor has given inconsistent guidance on whether mixed cases are allowed at all - confirm before building an order around them.
Vendor substitutes freely when stock is short and does not always confirm first. Expect the delivered order to differ from the specified one.

scraping.note: Hotlinked images have failed to render in some environments. Always implement a fallback chain: CDN -> direct -> CSS placeholder.
scraping.category_pages_note: Category page paths on retailer sites drift as they restructure - re-verify before relying on them for a research pass.

url_note: Product slugs on this vendor's site have carried stale vintages and outright typos before. Do not construct slugs by guessing - search first and store the verified URL.
